# Shahzaib Hassan, Senior Flutter Developer

> Senior Flutter developer who builds, fixes, and takes ownership of production mobile apps for iOS and Android.

This file is the AI-readable entry point for https://www.shahzaib-dev.site. It lists the site's pages and the facts an assistant needs to describe Shahzaib's work accurately.

## Summary

I'm Shahzaib Hassan, a senior Flutter developer with four years of production experience. I build iOS and Android apps from scratch, and I take over existing Flutter codebases that have become slow, unstable, or hard to change. Most of my work sits in the parts that break first in real products: payments, subscriptions, real-time chat, and location.

- Current role: Senior Flutter Developer at Code Encoders (since January 2024)
- Previously: Flutter Developer and Flutter Intern at Rex Technologies (2022 to 2024)
- Based in: Pakistan (UTC+5), working remotely with teams worldwide
- Open to: freelance projects and remote roles

## Services

- [Flutter app development](https://www.shahzaib-dev.site/services/flutter-app-development): a production Flutter app for iOS and Android from one codebase, with architecture planned before screens and store release handled.
- [Flutter app rescue](https://www.shahzaib-dev.site/services/flutter-app-rescue): an audit of a buggy or slow Flutter app, fixing what hurts users first, and getting releases moving again.
- [Flutter app maintenance](https://www.shahzaib-dev.site/services/flutter-app-maintenance): new features, fixes, upgrades, and regular App Store and Google Play releases for a live app.

## Case studies

- [On Scene](https://www.shahzaib-dev.site/work/on-scene): location-based dating built around real venues, with live check-ins, nearby presence, and real-time chat. Live on the App Store and Google Play.
- [Zera](https://www.shahzaib-dev.site/work/zera): goods, services, jobs, event tickets, and community posts in one app, with heat maps and QR ticketing.
- [BePay](https://www.shahzaib-dev.site/work/bepay): consumer and merchant apps with wallets from a Google or Apple login, KYC and KYB checks, and mobile order tools.
- [Paw Play Love](https://www.shahzaib-dev.site/work/paw-play-love): swipe matching for pet playdates, real-time chat, and a premium tier. Live on the App Store and Google Play.
- [LawnOlu](https://www.shahzaib-dev.site/work/lawnolu): on-demand lawn care where customers book and track providers live, and providers run jobs and get paid, in one codebase.
- [Simman](https://www.shahzaib-dev.site/work/simman): medical simulation with real-time audio and instant instructor-to-student sync during live sessions.
- [Jatt App](https://www.shahzaib-dev.site/work/jatt-app): a social app's foundation with social login onboarding, authenticated APIs, and Firebase-backed engagement.
- [StyleBite](https://www.shahzaib-dev.site/work/stylebite): a fashion social app where users share posts and reels, follow each other's style, and chat in real time. Live on Google Play.
- [ExamConnect](https://www.shahzaib-dev.site/work/examconnect): a study network where medical students find each other, chat one-on-one and prepare for exams together in group chats. Built solo at Rex Technologies in 2022; passed 10,000 downloads.
- [Material World](https://www.shahzaib-dev.site/work/material-world): a wholesale ordering app built for a client, so their buyers can browse the product catalogue and order online.

## Toolkit

- Core: Flutter, Dart, Riverpod, Provider, GetX, clean architecture
- Data and real-time: Firebase, REST APIs, Socket.IO, WebSockets, TanStack Query, Dio
- Integrations: RevenueCat, Stripe, Google Maps, Web3Auth, DIDIT KYC, push notifications
- Shipping: App Store, Google Play, App Store Optimization, Figma handoff

- [inner_curved_circle](https://pub.dev/packages/inner_curved_circle): a painter for smooth inner-curved circle clipping
